final: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) as track_count, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT)/t.Milliseconds) as byte_rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall_avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as overall_avg FROM media_type_stats), above_average AS (SELECT mts.track_count, mts.byte_rate, (mts.byte_rate - oar.overall_avg) as excess FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN overall_avg_rate oar WHERE mts.byte_rate > oar.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as avg_rate, AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_average
